java_trace.3_letters: StartUtils#isWordOrTilde (utils/StartUtils.java:82-84) is '~', '_' or Character#isLetterOrDigit(char): general category Lu, Ll, Lt, Lm, Lo or Nd of one UTF-16 unit. JDK 21 uses Unicode 15.0. UnicodeData.txt 15.0.0 sha256 806e9aed65037197f1ec85e12be6e8cd870fc5608b4de0fffd990f689f376a73 (https://www.unicode.org/Public/15.0.0/ucd/UnicodeData.txt) has 48,965 BMP letters in 380 inclusive ranges. UnicodeData.txt 17.0.0 sha256 2e1efc1dcb59c575eedf5ccae60f95229f706ee6d031835247d843c11d96470c adds exactly sixteen BMP letters and removes none: U+088F, U+0C5C, U+0CDC, U+1C89, U+1C8A, U+A7CB, U+A7CC, U+A7CD, U+A7CE, U+A7CF, U+A7D2, U+A7D4, U+A7DA, U+A7DB, U+A7DC, U+A7F1. Nd stays on the existing BMP digit table. A supplementary scalar is two surrogates and is neither.

planned_rust_changes.1: execute_one_line always sets line_no_comment from remove_inner_comment(line). The EBNF branch goes away. The whole-line apostrophe skip stays EBNF-exempt (CodeIteratorShortComment is a different iterator; EBNF terminals use apostrophes). The definelong collector buffers current_buffered_line(&line_no_comment).
planned_rust_changes.2: When a theme body has no nested theme, project_events joins that body's TimLines with the same loadInternal join before flatten_theme_output. A continuation with no following line inside the body keeps its backslash: Java would join it with the next result-list line, which is outside the body and still not in this stream. A body that contains a nested theme is left unjoined, so a join cannot skip the nested body.
planned_rust_changes.3: Replace java_is_letter_or_digit's unicode-properties general-category call with the generated BMP letter ranges. Remove the unicode-properties dependency from rustuml-parser. A unit test asserts the sixteen Unicode-17-only letters are not letters, that the range table covers 48,965 BMP letters, and that before_start_uml treats U+1C89, U+A7CB, U+A7CE and U+088F as a header prefix.
planned_rust_changes.4: No baseline edit until the tip's golden_no_oracle failure-name diff says edge_pragma_useVerticalIf passed and names no other movement. Doc pins move in the same commit as the baseline, only if the total moves.
